biography.value:
Orium dragons are greedy and calculating, and they believe every coin in the world belongs in their hoards. They bargain, scheme and steal, and they never forget a theft from their own treasure.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .i2L4So2hNkuYKh0x]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .1HYvfUa1fhjSWHyp]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .OMQbJz5soDiDG1mi]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=IgzJthZEQLFninLq]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=IgzJthZEQLFninLq]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=IgzJthZEQLFninLq]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=S63zo3j3ZBEn0bht]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses one of the following breath weapons.

Poison Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a cloud of green-gold poison in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=2q6z5P83S3j9UpIA]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=2q6z5P83S3j9UpIA]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=2q6z5P83S3j9UpIA]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Greed Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} unleashes its greed Breath in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=4M5Ms7RuZ1wMbHFS]]. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save activity=4M5Ms7RuZ1wMbHFS]] saving throw or be &Reference[charmed] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} until the end of its next turn, and drop whatever valuables it holds.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the direction and distance to any coin or gem from its hoard within 1 mile.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Poison gas fills a 20-foot sphere: DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) poison damage.
  • Coins in the hoard rise and swarm one creature: DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and be &Reference[blinded] until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • The dragon knows the location of every creature within 120 feet carrying treasure.
